text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while Fuji Kiseki is walking down the hallway…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ow… Why do my muscles hurt? But if the muscles in this area are hurting, it must mean…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I have a bad feeling about this. I'd better tell Trainer right awa—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: No, that'll just cause unnecessary worry. I should go to the infirmary and get checked out first…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you have a minute? You see, I felt some pain running down my leg today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I went to the infirmary to see what was wrong, and…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haha! Judging from your expression, my little prank worked.
choice_data_list: Your prank wasn't good for my heart…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Sorry, sorry. I don't blame you for being worried. I was scared at first too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm usually never sore because I used to dance so much, and I've never felt pain in this particular area.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But if they're sore now, it must mean that I'm training and strengthening muscles I wasn't able to before in dance.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And it's all thanks to a certain someone's very effective training regime. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yep. This has been a learning experience for me too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: New doors have opened, and I can fly even more magnificently down the turf than before… I'm counting on you to keep up the good work, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems that Fuji Kiseki's learned she still has a long ways to go in terms of training.
